recipe: Hybrid (Cut 2a, 09-02-26): the original sixteen keep their Phase 0 embedding sims; every edge touching a promoted topic is IDF-weighted tag co-occurrence, rescaled per row to the embedding graph's mean spread. See scripts/rebuild-topic-graph.ts.
note: Mean-centered topic centroids over the curated corpus. Positive head of each row = drift bridges, tail half = jump pool. Hand-editable: rows with max sim < 0.06 are noise and should be curated by hand (see WEAK ROWS in the build output).
